title: Intrusion-Detection-System-using-LSTM-that-Detect-Adversarial-Attack-using-NSL-KDD-dataset
summary: A Jupyter notebook project training an LSTM-based network intrusion detection system on the NSL-KDD dataset to recognize adversarial attack traffic. The notebooks import CTGAN, SDV's tabular CopulaGAN/evaluation API, and the standalone copulas library, apparently to generate synthetic or adversarial network-traffic samples for the detector, with SDV's CopulaGAN synthesizer and evaluate() function imported but never clearly shown being fit or run.
evidence: IDS copy.ipynb:3610 'from sdv.tabular import CopulaGAN'; :3629 'from sdv.evaluation import evaluate'; :27 'from copulas.multivariate import GaussianMultivariate'
needs: Only import statements for ctgan/sdv/copulas are visible; no fit() or sample() calls confirm actual execution, and one ctgan import fails with ModuleNotFoundError, so real usage cannot be verified from this evidence.
